tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Julklappsspel. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, defaultDomain, catalogCount, and marketplaces[] (domain, label, tagConfigured). Use this first. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts. Pick the user's marketplace: amazon.com for the US, amazon.se for Sweden. If you omit it, en-US requests get amazon.com and everything else amazon.se.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for party organizer / julklappsspel gifts on the user's marketplace. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (English, USD budgets) or amazon.se for Sweden; if omitted, en-US gets amazon.com, else amazon.se. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated party gift starters. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (English, USD budgets) or amazon.se for Sweden; if omitted, en-US gets amazon.com, else amazon.se. Search remains primary discovery. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (trackingTag null until enrolled). Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (English, USD budgets) or amazon.se for Sweden; if omitted, en-US gets amazon.com, else amazon.se. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a party gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated Christmas gift game (julklappsspel / secret santa) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_and_fill" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
